info.name: Data Agent — End-to-End (local, no-JWT)
info.description: Drives the full agent turn locally. Orchestrator/workflow-runtime have no auth in dev — identity comes from forged X-Tenant-Id / X-User-ID / X-User-Roles headers (same as the k6 scripts). Set the collection variables, then run 'Agent turn (stream)'. Prereqs: orchestrator (:8003), workflow-runtime (:8001), litellm (:4000 → ollama). See KB-SCALE-10K / docker-compose.agent-test.yml.

item.name: 1. Agent turn (stream) — single agent
item.description: The main end-to-end entry point. SSE stream (text/event-stream). agent_id set → single-agent path (planner→responder→judge). Response is 'data: ...' frames ending with 'data: [DONE]'. First frame carries {"__session_id": "..."}. Postman shows the raw stream in the body.

item.name: 2. Agent turn (stream) — multi-agent (ToT planner)
item.description: Omit agent_id → the orchestrator's Tree-of-Thoughts planner fans out to multiple agents (several extra LLM calls, much heavier). Use to measure worst-case turn cost.

item.name: 3. Resume (HITL clarification)
item.description: Only when a turn emits a {"__clarification":{...}} frame before [DONE]. Copy __session_id from the stream into session_id. Returns JSON (not SSE).

item.name: 4. (downstream) workflow-runtime conversation run
item.description: The single-agent executor the orchestrator calls per agent. Direct SSE; useful to isolate agent-execution latency from the orchestrator layer.

item.name: 5. (LLM tier) litellm chat completion
item.description: The LLM the agent funnels into (the bottleneck). Isolates raw LLM latency. Needs the sk-dev key.
